entities.name: Zhu Zaiyu, Prince of Zheng
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zhu Zaiyu was a Chinese scholar, mathematician and music theorist. He was a prince of the Chinese Ming dynasty. In 1584, Zhu innovatively described the equal temperament via accurate mathematical calculation.
